# Verbatim examples of the retired claims in retired-claims.txt, as they were
# actually published before correction.
#
# CI asserts both directions: every line here is still caught by some pattern,
# and every pattern still catches at least one line here. That is what keeps the
# guard from silently degrading into one that runs, matches nothing, and passes.
#
# Never edit a line here to make CI green. If a line stops being caught, the
# pattern is broken — fix the pattern.
